interpretation.direction_scope: Each block ratio and its median describe this one window; mixed marks differing block direction labels
interpretation.inference: Descriptive 10 percent granularity only; no 2 percent, causal, tail, adoption or optimization conclusion
interpretation.native_claim: Producer timing_evidence=false is unchanged; execution authority and qualification are separate wrapper artifacts
interpretation.normalized_metrics: batch_ns divided by owners for create/destroy; by 8192 for allocate/free
interpretation.preruns: Six whole fresh processes excluded; they do not prewarm later process-local state
interpretation.qualification: Each cell requires all AA, block dispersion and anchor drift <= 1.10; comparisons require both cells
interpretation.range: Observed six-block minimum/maximum, not a confidence interval
interpretation.throughput: 8192 requests divided by batch seconds for allocate/free
interpretation.time_basis: Existing main-clock barrier-to-barrier batch wall time; four phases separate
interpretation.uncertainty: Unqualified cells and comparisons remain present with uncertain status
